intro: Romans is Paul's fullest explanation of the good news, written to the Christians in Rome, a church he had not yet visited.
Chapters one to eight explain how all have sinned, and how we are made right with God through faith in Jesus, ending with: nothing can separate us from the love of God.
Chapters nine to eleven wrestle with God's plan for Israel. Chapters twelve to sixteen show how to live it out: a living sacrifice, love, and peace.
Paul wrote it about fifty-seven years after Christ's birth.
It's dense, so don't worry about catching every argument. Listen for chapter eight, one of the most loved chapters in the Bible.
